title: 第23章 欧阳克穿越记下第24章 过渡章
content_zh:
双方都有火气的情况下，这打斗场面自然是不容小觑了！
欧阳锋对于自己的老对手东邪北丐自然不会手下留情，毕竟中间还有自己被愚弄和侄儿断腿的仇怨在！黄蓉昔日在桃花岛上对白驼山庄的诋毁他也没有忘！
更何况他如今也不是吴下阿蒙了，即使没有九阴真经在手，他也无惧此二人！
东邪北丐自然是了解欧阳锋为人的，本来看着他陪自家侄儿回了白驼山庄，也就没在关注，但今日看他一副寻仇的模样，便知道来者不善了！即使是二人心里早有准备，但面对欧阳锋的含恨出手也不免有些力不从心！
洪七公昔日身中蛇毒，如今虽然修炼九阴真经，但武功却还没有恢复！
黄药师虽然也练了九阴真经，但却并没有多上心！他对九阴真经的执念来源于自家妻子，且操心自家女儿的他也并没有那么多时间去修炼！
要知道欧阳锋可是专心致志的修炼了多样少林武学，如此一来，欧阳锋即使以一敌二也丝毫不落下风！
郭靖黄蓉虽然有心上前帮忙，但欧阳克也不是吃素的！
即使这二人有奇遇在身，但也敌不过欧阳克！毕竟他手里握着的少林武学是经过叔父前世改良的版本，结合白驼山庄家传武学更是威力不凡！
没过多久，胜负已经分明，看着对面的四个人，欧阳克心里思绪万千！
欧阳锋看着昔日对手的样子，只觉得自己圆满了！以一敌二还赢了，自己如今已是真正的天下第一！
黄蓉不可置信的看着自家师傅和爹爹，她实在无法相信欧阳锋的武学已经到了如此地步，但事实摆在眼前，由不得她不信！
“黄蓉，我当日看在长辈是故交的份上多次对你手下留情，但在荒岛之上，你设计毁我双腿，此仇不能不报，今日我也毁去你的双腿，让你也体会一番不良于行的苦楚，这算是因果报应！”欧阳克说完就直接动手毁了黄蓉的腿，然后和自家叔父一起离开了华山！
欧阳锋其实本想把对手赶尽杀绝的！但瞧着对手那惨兮兮的模样，想了想也就放弃了！毕竟他还是需要陪练和前进的动力的！
欧阳锋叔侄离开后，在场的四人才回过神来。
洪七公没想到欧阳锋在短短时间内武功居然变了这么多，心里倒是好奇老毒物为什么没对他们赶尽杀绝！
郭靖和黄药师看着黄蓉痛苦的模样，恨不得将欧阳克大卸八块！但形势比人强，他们目前打不过对方，又何谈报仇呢！
黄蓉眼睁睁的看着自己的双腿被欧阳克毁了，心里十分愤恨！
往日里欧阳克对她的特殊照顾她不是不知道，但心里只有靖哥哥她根本不在意，但看着欧阳克如今毫不犹豫毁了自己的腿，这让她如何能接受！
四个人也没有在华山多待，毕竟黄蓉的腿还需要尽快找人医治，黄药师虽然也精通医术，但却毫无办法！毕竟昔日他几个弟子只要脚筋断了尚且无法根治，更何况黄蓉是腿断了呢！

但想着术业有专攻，早点下山还能让其他医术高明的人看一看！
然而，就在这四人离开华山之后，西毒欧阳锋成为天下第一的消息，就像一阵风一样，迅速在江湖上传播开来！
有些人自封侠义之士，对欧阳锋的行事作风那是相当担心，生怕他在江湖上兴风作浪！不过还好，欧阳锋一下山就带着自家侄儿回到西域研究武学秘籍去了，压根儿就没再踏进中原一步。至于欧阳克倒是一门心思全扑在西域的商道上啦，他要重新打造一个属于自己的商业王国，有了上辈子经验的他做起这些事情自然是得心应手！这么一来，西域的白驼山庄自然是更加声名远扬啦！
黄蓉的腿伤终究未能痊愈，这致使黄蓉的心境彻底崩塌！她难以接受行动不便的自己，故而千方百计寻求治疗之法，然皆成效甚微！
实际上，众人皆知欧阳家持有疗伤之药，然而无人开口讨要！
众人深知，欧阳克曾经也受过断腿之伤，如今却恢复如初，但他与黄蓉有仇，定然不会赠与，毕竟黄蓉的腿伤就是他干的！
至于以武力强取，无异于是在痴人说梦！欧阳锋仅是闭关修炼，尚未身死，有他撑腰的欧阳克又怎么会惧怕！
但对于一向骄傲的黄蓉而言，不良于行真的是比杀了她还要痛苦！这也算是欧阳克对她最大的报复了！
时间一久，毫无办法的黄蓉只好慢慢接受现实，黄药师倒是还未死心，想要以桃花岛换取良药，毕竟欧阳克在筹建商道的事情早就传扬开来，桃花岛的财力还是很可观的！
但令黄药师没想到的是，欧阳克拒绝了！
这一次蒙古大举南侵，郭靖还是走向了抗蒙的道路，只不过这次可没有原着的待遇了，毕竟曾经的他是蒙古的金刀驸马，还因为二女争一男而名动江湖，这让大家怎么可能放心！
不过粗枝大叶的郭靖倒是没注意到周围人对他的提防，反而每天都坚持着抗蒙，时间一长，大家也慢慢对他改观了！但金国早就没了，蒙古势力也不是大宋能抵挡的！
直到最后郭靖黄蓉在襄阳殉城的消息传来，欧阳克才发现这二人兜兜转转还是走了原来的老路，不过他也不在意了！
看着又在自己面前喋喋不休的叔父，欧阳克一时倒是有些分不清前世今生了！
论原着恋爱脑的欧阳克看见自看见叔父喋喋不休的样子有多惊恐！
被穆念慈杀死的欧阳克看到叔父在自己死后收杨康为徒，心里十分复杂！
虽然对自家叔父的所作所为并不赞同，但欧阳克不信自己的死因叔父看不出来，没想到在叔父的眼中自己竟然不值一提！
想到这，欧阳克不免自嘲的笑了笑！
他其实对武功并不关心，只想知道一生中到底有谁真的爱过他！
回想起自己这一生，自己似乎真心爱过四个人，但却都无疾而终！

自己爱母亲，但母亲心中只有父亲；自己爱爹（欧阳锋），爹却只爱九阴真经；自己爱黄蓉，黄蓉却只爱郭靖，自己爱穆念慈，穆念慈心里只有杨康。
幽魂一般的的欧阳克只觉得心灰意冷，对世间再无留恋！
然而，令他始料未及的是，自己不过是稍作闲逛，眼前忽地闪过一道耀眼的白光，使人难以睁眼。待到他睁眼之际，竟望见自家叔父正喋喋不休！
看叔父的样子，也不像是自言自语啊！
欧阳克心中不禁生出一个巨大的疑问！在他的记忆之中，叔父行事向来都是干脆利落，直爽坦率！毕竟，时间乃是钻研武学之根本，叔父自是不会在无关之事上耗费光阴！
content_en:
With both sides feeling angry, this fight scene should not be underestimated!
Ouyang Feng would naturally not be merciful to his old rival Dongxie Beibei. After all, he still had a grudge against himself for being fooled and for his nephew's broken leg! He has not forgotten Huang Rong's slander against White Camel Villa on Peach Blossom Island!
What's more, he is no longer Wu Xia Amen. Even if he doesn't have the Nine Yin Sutra in hand, he has nothing to fear from these two!
Dongxie Beibei naturally knew Ouyang Feng as a person. He originally watched him accompany his nephew back to White Camel Villa and didn't pay attention to him. But seeing him looking like he was seeking revenge today, he knew that the person who came here was evil! Even though the two of them had been prepared in advance, they still felt powerless in the face of Ouyang Feng's hateful attack!
Hong Qigong was poisoned by snake venom in the past. Although he is practicing the Nine Yin Manual, his martial arts has not recovered yet!
Although Huang Yaoshi also practiced the Nine Yin Manual, he didn't pay much attention to it! His obsession with the Nine Yin Manual comes from his wife, and he doesn’t have that much time to practice since he is worried about his daughter!
You must know that Ouyang Feng has devoted himself to practicing various Shaolin martial arts. In this way, Ouyang Feng will not fall behind even if he is one against two!
Although Guo Jing and Huang Rong wanted to help, Ouyang Ke was not a vegetarian!
Even if these two people have an adventure, they are no match for Ouyang Ke! After all, the Shaolin martial arts he holds in his hand is an improved version of his uncle's previous life. Combined with the martial arts passed down by the White Camel Mountain Zhuang family, it is even more powerful!
Not long after, the winner was clear. Looking at the four people opposite, Ouyang Ke had a lot of thoughts in his heart!
Ouyang Feng looked at his former opponent and felt that he was complete! One against two, he won, and now he is truly number one in the world!
Huang Rong looked at her master and father in disbelief. She really couldn't believe that Ouyang Feng's martial arts had reached such an extent, but with the facts before her eyes, she couldn't help but not believe it!
"Huang Rong, I showed mercy to you many times because we are old friends. But on the desert island, you designed to destroy my legs. This revenge must be avenged. Today I will also destroy your legs and let you experience the pain of not being able to do what you want. This is karma!" After Ouyang Ke said this, he directly destroyed Huang Rong's legs, and then left Huashan with his uncle!
Ouyang Feng actually wanted to drive all his opponents away! But looking at the miserable appearance of my opponent, I gave up after thinking about it! After all, he still needs sparring and motivation to move forward!
After Ouyang Feng's uncle and nephew left, the four people present came to their senses.
Hong Qigong didn't expect that Ouyang Feng's martial arts had changed so much in a short period of time, and he was curious why the old poisoner didn't kill them all!
Seeing Huang Rong's painful expression, Guo Jing and Huang Yaoshi wanted to cut Ouyang Ke into pieces! But the situation is stronger than the people. They can't defeat each other at the moment, so how can they talk about revenge!
Huang Rong watched helplessly as her legs were destroyed by Ouyang Ke, feeling very resentful!
She was not unaware of Ouyang Ke's special care for her in the past, but she only cared about Brother Jing in her heart. But seeing Ouyang Ke destroying her legs without hesitation now, how could she accept it!
The four of them did not stay in Huashan longer. After all, Huang Rong's leg still needed to be treated as soon as possible. Although Huang Yaoshi was also proficient in medical skills, there was nothing he could do! After all, in the past, several of his disciples could not cure their broken hamstrings, let alone Huang Rong's broken leg!
But thinking that there is a specialization in the art, going down the mountain early can also let other people with good medical skills take a look!
However, just after these four people left Huashan, the news that Xidu Ouyang Feng became the best in the world spread quickly throughout the world like a gust of wind!
Some people call themselves chivalrous men and are very worried about Ouyang Feng's behavior, fearing that he will cause trouble in the world! Fortunately, Ouyang Feng took his nephew back to the Western Regions to study martial arts secrets as soon as he got off the mountain.I never set foot in the Central Plains again. As for Ouyang Ke, he is completely focused on the business routes in the Western Regions. He wants to rebuild a business kingdom of his own. With his experience in his previous life, he is naturally comfortable in doing these things! In this way, White Camel Villa in the Western Regions will naturally become more famous!
Huang Rong's leg injury failed to heal after all, which caused Huang Rong's mental state to completely collapse! It was difficult for her to accept her mobility impairment, so she tried every means to seek treatment, but with little success!
In fact, everyone knew that the Ouyang family had healing medicine, but no one asked for it!
Everyone knows that Ouyang Ke once suffered a broken leg, but now he has recovered as before. However, he has a grudge against Huang Rong, so he will definitely not give it to Huang Rong. After all, he was the one who caused Huang Rong's leg injury!
As for taking it by force, it is nothing more than wishful thinking! Ouyang Feng was just practicing in seclusion and was not dead yet. How could Ouyang Ke be afraid with his support!
But for Huang Rong, who has always been proud, failing to behave is really more painful than killing her! This can be regarded as Ouyang Ke's greatest revenge on her!
As time passed, Huang Rong had no choice but to slowly accept the reality. Huang Yaoshi had not given up yet and wanted to exchange Peach Blossom Island for good medicine. After all, Ouyang Ke's preparations for building a business road had been spread for a long time, and Peach Blossom Island's financial resources were still considerable!
But what Huang Yaoshi didn't expect was that Ouyang Ke refused!
This time Mongolia invaded the south in a big way, Guo Jing still went on the road of resisting Mongolia, but this time he didn't get the treatment as the original author. After all, he was once the golden sword consort of Mongolia, and he was famous for his fight between two women for one man. How could everyone rest assured!
However, the careless Guo Jing did not notice that the people around him were wary of him. Instead, he persisted in fighting against it every day. As time went by, everyone gradually changed their view of him! But the Kingdom of Jin has long since disappeared, and the Mongolian power cannot be resisted by the Song Dynasty!
It wasn't until the news of Guo Jing and Huang Rong's death in Xiangyang finally came that Ouyang Ke realized that these two people were going the same old way, but he didn't care anymore!
Looking at his uncle who was chattering in front of him again, Ouyang Ke couldn't tell the difference between past and present life for a moment!
On the Original Love Brain, Ouyang Ke saw how frightened he was when he saw his uncle talking incessantly!
Ouyang Ke, who was killed by Mu Nianci, felt very complicated when he saw his uncle accepting Yang Kang as his disciple after his death!
Although he didn't agree with what his uncle did, Ouyang Ke didn't believe that his uncle couldn't see the cause of his death. He didn't expect that he was not worth mentioning in his uncle's eyes!
Thinking of this, Ouyang Ke couldn't help but smile to himself!
He actually doesn't care about martial arts, he just wants to know who really loves him in his life!
Looking back on my life, I seem to have truly loved four people, but they all ended in vain!
He loves his mother, but his mother only loves his father; he loves his father (Ouyang Feng), but his father only loves Jiuyin Zhenjing; he loves Huang Rong, but Huang Rong only loves Guo Jing; he loves Mu Nianci, but Mu Nianci only loves Yang Kang.
The ghostly Ouyang Ke only felt disheartened and had no nostalgia for the world!
However, what he didn't expect was that while he was just wandering around for a while, a dazzling white light suddenly flashed in front of his eyes, making it difficult to open his eyes. When he opened his eyes, he saw his uncle chattering incessantly!
From the look of my uncle, he didn’t look like he was talking to himself!
Ouyang Ke couldn't help but have a huge question in his heart! In his memory, his uncle had always acted neatly, straightforwardly and frankly! After all, time is the foundation of studying martial arts, and my uncle will not waste time on irrelevant things!
